description: This file defines a singleton object CanvasActionTrust which manages and verifies trusted URLs for canvas actions within an Android application, including URL normalization, matching, and trust verification logic.

methods.name: isTrustedCanvasActionUrl
methods.description: Checks if a given URL is trusted based on normalization and matching against a list of trusted URLs.

methods.name: matchesTrustedRemoteA2uiUrlExact
methods.description: Compares a candidate URI against a trusted URL for exact match after normalization.

methods.name: normalizeTrustedRemoteA2uiUri
methods.description: Normalizes a URI by lowercasing scheme and host, and keeping only certain URL components, to align with Android trust requirements.

methods.name: parseUri
methods.description: Attempts to parse a string into a URI object, returning null on failure.
